dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hi there! I'm following up on my home loan application I submitted recently. It was for a **$105,000 conventional loan** for **home improvement**, with a **30-year term**. I'm just looking for an update — has a decision been made yet? Was I approved or denied?
dialogue.agent:
Thank you for reaching out. Yes, a decision has been made on your application.

Congratulations — your loan was **originated**, meaning it was approved and the funds have been issued. Your loan is for **$105,000** with a **30-year term** at an interest rate of **6.375%**. 

Would you like me to provide any other details about your loan?

dialogue.user: Oh, that's great news! I'm so relieved — thank you. So I was approved. Could you tell me a bit more about the total costs of the loan? And also, are there any flags on it like a high-cost mortgage or negative amortization feature I should be aware of?
dialogue.agent:
I'm glad to share the details.

Your **total loan costs** came to **$3,144.10**. 

Regarding your other questions — no, this loan is **not classified as a high-cost mortgage** under HOEPA, and there is **no negative amortization feature**. It's a standard conventional loan with those protections in place.

Is there anything else you'd like to know about your loan?

dialogue.user:
That's good to know — thank you for explaining that clearly. No high-cost flags and no negative amortization, that's reassuring.

One last thing — has my loan been sold or transferred to another institution at all? I just want to make sure I know who to make payments to.
dialogue.agent:
Yes, your loan was sold after origination. It was purchased by a credit union, mortgage company, or finance company. You should have received or will receive a notice from the new servicer with instructions on where to make payments.

If you don't have that notice, I'd recommend contacting the new servicer directly using the information they provided.

dialogue.user:
Alright, I understand. That's helpful to know — at least I'll keep an eye out for that notice.

I think that answers all my questions for now. Thank you for walking me through everything, you were clear and straightforward. I really appreciate it.

I'd say I'm **Satisfied** — I got all the information I needed, and you delivered it in a polite and professional way.
dialogue.agent: Thank you for your kind words. I'm glad I could provide the information you needed in a clear and helpful way. Best of luck with your home improvement project!

dialogue.user: Thank you so much! Have a great day. 😊
dialogue.agent: You're very welcome! Have a great day too. 😊

dialogue.user: Best wishes to you too! Goodbye! 😊

dialogue.agent: It was a pleasure helping you. Take care!
